reason: PURE. The first thing I saw was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR on the front, and I scan that before I buy anything. If the report opens on a real ISO 17025 lab and the numbers match, I would try one box of the bisglycinate for travel, since sachets beat a bottle in a carry-on.
objection: I already have a magnesium that works for me, and this brand has zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal, so the lab report is only the brand's word until I see it. $29.99 is also not cheap for something I would be switching to on faith.
would_change_my_mind: A batch report that actually opens from the QR with a named lab, real heavy metal and magnesium results, and a few verified reviews. NSF or USP certification would make me buy a second box.
